authorization_basis: User-authorized creation of a reviewable physical prototype package in the current AICAD task.
authority_boundary: This input authorizes controlled geometry generation only. It is not professional engineering approval, a supplier specification, a safety certification, or manufacturing release.

product_intent.use: indoor, dry, supervised low-energy interaction testing
forbidden_uses: direct drone propulsion or flight-control power switching

controlled_load_cases.case: self weight plus 3 g equivalent gesture acceleration
controlled_load_cases.generation_constraint: Preserve continuous GFRP spine support and minimum declared polymer wall; do not infer strength approval without material coupons and calculation evidence.
Keep the actuator center at the declared datum and provide a guarded recessed opening.
Use positive diametral clearances; adhesive retention remains a coupon-test item.

controlled_load_cases.case: drop, impact, misuse, thermal runaway, or tip contact
controlled_load_cases.generation_constraint: No design acceptance is claimed; these cases remain release blockers pending risk review and physical verification.

materials_and_processes.polymer_parts: prototype polymers only; lot, conditioning, orientation, flammability and final process are not qualified
materials_and_processes.spine: supplier grade, fibre fraction, modulus, surface preparation and certificates must be selected before structural review
materials_and_processes.adhesive: no production adhesive selected; lap-shear and ageing coupons required

tolerance_policy.critical_interfaces: Use explicit bilateral limits from design-parameters.json; do not apply a general tolerance over those limits.
tolerance_policy.datum_scheme: A = rear outer plane, B = common wand axis, C = press-to-arm radial center plane
tolerance_policy.surface_texture: No production roughness value assigned; remove sharp edges and burrs on prototypes.

rf_mechanical_policy.mechanical_keepout: Use the explicit axial/radial envelope and forbidden-item classes in design-parameters.json.
rf_mechanical_policy.external_authority_required: Current u-blox NINA-B302 antenna integration documentation and a representative enclosure RF test.

digital: AICAD schema and geometric invariant checks
physical: dimensional inspection of all critical interfaces
verification_policy.native_host: SolidWorks native save/reopen and topology readback are required before native authority can be claimed.
